answer: More aliases means more devices and more keys, each with its own sonnet proof, and each must still clear the dune grading gate to earn. Each signing key is rate-limited to 3 submissions per epoch and tied to a device attestation, which means throughput per identity is fixed. The delta counter resets at epoch open, which makes the throughput ceiling permanent rather than something a patient copycat can outlast. That is 7 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
